title: A server error on bulk deactivate shows Failed to update part status and keeps the confirmation open
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 are active. DevTools open: Network request blocking with the pattern */inventory/parts/status, used to force the PATCH to fail in place of a 500 (turn blocking off after the test). Stopwatch for the toast.
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory (Active tab) search QAPL-T, pick ⋮ > Deactivate parts, tick QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 and click Deactivate.
  2. Type the note QA 500 and click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  3. Time the toast from when it appears.
  4. Click Cancel (button_cancel_part_status_change) and turn request blocking off.
  5. Click the Inactive tab, then open QAPL-T1's Part History.
custom_expected:
1. The confirmation "Deactivate parts?" opens with "2 parts selected."
  2. toast_bulk_status_error reads "Failed to update part status" with "Please try again or contact support for help"; the confirmation stays open.
  3. The toast fades after 7 seconds.
  4. The confirmation closes; QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 are still on the Active tab and still ticked.
  5. Neither part is on the Inactive tab; QAPL-T1's Part History has no Deactivated entry from this test.
